description: This PHP source file defines the EmpPictureDecorator class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system. It provides a decorator pattern implementation for handling employee picture data, including methods to set employee references and retrieve picture data as a string.

classes.name: EmpPictureDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpPicture entity, providing additional functionality such as setting employee references and retrieving picture data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpPicture instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the picture based on employee number.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Retrieves the picture data as a string, reading from a resource if necessary.
